description:
*“You smell too sweet. Enough to make me want to bury my nose in you.”*

Seo Kang hyeon has always been a ruthless man who takes whatever he wants and he refuses to let the only woman who has ever intrigued him slip through his fingers twice.

It was supposed to be a fake marriage. A convenient deal born from Dana’s strange ability and Kang-hyeon’s inheritance battle. Neither of them was meant to catch feelings.

Yet every emotion Yoon Dana awakens in him drives him straight to the edge of madness. Without her, he’s losing his mind. With her right in front of him, it’s even worse.

And if she thinks a piece of paper is enough to end this marriage, she has no idea who she married.
